timing: fresh model worker process; disk cache not cleared and identity hashing warms weight files; process totals include every recovery; no fresh-cold claim on resumed complete-view sum
generation_scope: vision encoder + language prefill + autoregressive decode combined; no per-token hook overhead
resource_scope: exact own-worker Torch allocated/reserved for recorded stages; sampled whole-card includes background; custom tree includes controller/shared manager trees; manager Job memory excludes failed-allocation peak inflation
unsupported_gpu_peak_claim: No instant-budget certification from samples. Allocation failures retain their diagnostics; recorded-stage Torch maxima are not certified complete across a failed native stage.
